name: shifts a saturated shard then closes the later gap
input: four partially overlapping inclusive ranges under limit two

name: limit one shifts later ranges without removing earlier coverage
input: two overlapping ranges under a single-cover limit

name: same-start ranges move to the first remaining capacity
input: four ranges that begin at the same key

name: handles empty singleton sparse and negative-coordinate inputs
input: an empty list plus ranges that require gap closing across zero
test:
assert rebalance_shards(3, []) == []
assert rebalance_shards(1, ['one:-3:-3']) == ['one:-3:-3']
assert rebalance_shards(2, ['left:-5:-4', 'right:2:3']) == ['left:-5:1', 'right:2:3']
